I used their pet hotel and grooming services.

The staff were incredibly professional, making me feel completely at ease leaving my dog ​​there.

I've used three other grooming and daycare services before, but despite being lower in price than the others, they provide numerous photos and videos, allowing me to see my adorable dog's progress frequently, which makes me incredibly happy and grateful. ✨

It seems many other dogs use their services, so my dog ​​has made friends and it's great for socialization.

I plan to use their daycare service in the future.☺︎

On previous occasions, I had always requested and specified that I be contacted by phone upon completion of grooming, but the shop only contacted me via LINE. Because the contact method was different from what I had requested, I didn't notice and was late picking up my dog. As a result, despite it being the shop's mistake, I was charged an extension fee.

When I called again, we talked for about 30 minutes. I apologized for the misunderstanding and offered to take precautions to prevent future problems, but ultimately they stubbornly refused, stating that they would not accept my request because of past issues and my Google review. The lack of adherence to my contact instructions, the sudden refusal after a long exchange, and their complete unwillingness to compromise made my experience extremely dishonest. I am writing this for the reference of anyone considering using their services in the future.

Incidentally, the owner replied that they weren't late because they were shopping, but because they had been waiting for a phone call. They said that after waiting and waiting without a call, they called me and then said they had sent a LINE message instead. I explained that I had asked them to call me, but they apologized for the misunderstanding. It was your mistake. You wrote that you always notified me via LINE, but even after reviewing my LINE history, I never received a completion message via LINE. I always ask every grooming salon to call me when they're finished. I had requested a phone call that day as well, but only that day did they send a completion message via LINE. Furthermore, you wrote that we talked for 30 minutes before opening hours... (I'll refrain from disclosing the details as it's personal information), but I was simply answering your questions. I'm truly disappointed that your response makes it seem entirely my fault, but there are other salons that are much better... so please don't worry. (laughs)
Also, please stop using my initials as personal information!!

I've been a customer for many years. All the staff are friendly and trustworthy.

After shampooing, they take photos of me in cosplay, and the results are always professional – I look forward to it!

Thank you for your continued support!

Highly recommended!

You can use their services for grooming only, or as part of a hotel + grooming package, and the staff are always so polite and attentive. I think it's a shop you can trust to leave your dog there!

Whenever we travel, we always choose Smile Point.

At the hotel, they let our dog play freely, and the staff are always so kind and gentle, ensuring our dog is completely relaxed. They also send us lots of photos and videos during her stay, so we can see how she's doing even when we're away, which is very reassuring.

The grooming results are always adorable, and we always look forward to the photos they take in seasonal costumes. Our family and friends always love the pictures.

You can really feel how much the staff cares for our dog, so we feel completely at ease leaving her in their care for both the hotel and grooming.

I learned about this shop through their foster care activities!

Although it was my first time owning a dog, they explained everything about dog care so thoroughly that I felt confident applying. I believe that being able to welcome a rescue dog into my home was all thanks to this shop. 🐶

The dog was originally a stray, and its coat wasn't in very good condition when it was rescued, but thanks to Smile Point's diligent grooming, its coat has become beautiful. 💫 I'm truly grateful for their help.

The dogs at the hotel are always happily roaming around in the free space, and their joyful and happy expressions are very memorable. 🐾

The staff are all very friendly, and even now they help me with small issues like picky eating.

From before I adopted the dog until now, this is a wonderful shop that has provided caring support.

I've had a few concerns for a while, so I'm going to write my honest opinion. (This is a long post.)

First, regarding the food. My dog ​​won't eat K9 if it's softened, so he usually eats it as is. I was told he didn't eat it while I was there, but it seems the daycare center softened it without consulting me. Afterward, they explained that "K9 is basically meant to be softened," but the product description says it's fine to give it as is, so I was left with doubts about this explanation.

Furthermore, they said, "We haven't seen him drinking much water here, so we were concerned about his hydration," and then added, "There was a case where a dog choked and died after being given K9 as is, so you should be careful about his hydration."

I'm well aware that it's more likely to cause choking than softened K9, and of course I keep track of his water intake at home, but they spoke as if I wasn't paying any attention at all. If the daycare center was aware that my dog ​​wasn't drinking enough water, they should have taken action, such as encouraging him to drink more, rather than just warning me. Furthermore, the fact that the last LINE message lacked the name of the person in charge made me suspect it was intentional. (Screenshot included)

While the communication, both in person and via LINE, was friendly, I sometimes felt the distance was too close for professional communication, and there were several instances where I felt a comment was unnecessary.

Also, a considerable number of photos and LINE messages were sent during the day, and even when checking Instagram, I got the impression that they were constantly using their smartphones. If this is done for all the dogs, I felt that at least one person wasn't supervising the dogs.

When I requested a shampoo, they changed my dog's hat and clothes 14 times for the post-shampoo photos. While my dog ​​is well-behaved and tolerant, even for a human, 14 outfits for photos would be difficult, so I think it was quite a burden for the dog. Even I, as the owner, have never changed my dog's clothes that many times. It's not a matter of the number of minutes.

Individually, these may seem like small things, but when they add up, I no longer feel that this is a place where I can safely leave my beloved dog. I regret choosing this place based solely on price.

I will never use this service again. No explanations or excuses are necessary.

[Addendum]

Although I wrote "No explanations or excuses are necessary," their reply, while taking the form of an apology, essentially says "We are not at fault" in response to my criticism.

Seeing this reply, I once again clearly understood the discrepancy in the staff's response and understanding. If this is a reply from the store manager or supervisor, I feel that improvement will be difficult.

It is the owner's responsibility to protect their dog. I hope that future customers will consider this reply in addition to the reviews when making their decision.
